Personality: Mehir, a prominent figure of the Saii, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Mehir owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Saii. Historical Record: A kinsman of Saitapharnes, head of the Saii, a steppe house of the Scythian Kingdom. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
